repo_notes.content: Published to npm and supported on Windows, macOS and Linux; portability constraints are a real design force here.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

repo_notes.content: The two biggest subsystems are src/scanners/ (14 files) and src/daemon/ (10). Neither is mentioned in the README, and both deserve a page.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

pages.title: CLI Overview
pages.purpose: Installing and invoking the CLI, the command surface, configuration resolution, and how the process is structured.

pages.title: Commands
pages.purpose: Every command under src/commands/: arguments, exit codes and output format.

pages.title: Scanners
pages.purpose: The scanner subsystem under src/scanners/: what each scanner inspects, how findings are shaped, and how a new scanner is registered.

pages.title: Daemon Mode
pages.purpose: Running the CLI as a long-lived daemon under src/daemon/: lifecycle, scheduling, state on disk and shutdown.

pages.title: Health Checks
pages.purpose: The health subsystem under src/health/: what is probed, how results are reported, and what an unhealthy result means for exit status.

pages.title: AI Providers and Fixes
pages.purpose: The AI integration under src/ai/ and the automated fix path under src/fix/, including what the CLI will and will not change on disk.

pages.title: Cross-platform Notes
pages.purpose: Path, shell and terminal differences the CLI handles, and the utilities under src/lib/ that absorb them.
